title: L1: Live round 1, labels-only arms 0/A/F/F-rand/A+F on dev-100 (bound ~2,450) -> STOP 1
description:
## Purpose

First live reading of the labels-only arms 0, A, F, F-rand and A+F on Emotion (A and A+F = harness A-c and A-c+F with an EMPTY comments input; no comment generation). Tests labels-only learning from disagreements; no stakeholder explanations exist in this dataset.

## Scope

Round 1 (150 labels), all arms scored on dev-100.

## Request bound and cost cap

Bound ~2,450 Jev requests (use the printed bound). Cap: ~$2.50 (no labeler calls; analyst only). Fresh ledger for this stage; gate needs `--max-new-requests` >= printed bound and <= ceiling; circuit breaker on; failures tallied by error class. Counts toward the hard cumulative cap of $10.

## Stop-point checks

**STOP 1** (owner looks): are A's elements (from disagreements only) sensible; did the feature cap fire. No L2 until the owner says go.

## Definition of done

Dev-100 table per arm (macro-F1, acc, per-class recall); elements and dropped elements listed; actual spend.

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)

comments.text: Done 2026-10-02 (STOP 1 reached): live round 1 labels-only, 150 labels, scored on dev-100 (noisy: ~2 'surprise' items), 1,660 Jev requests, 0 failures, free cached zero-shot baseline imported (700 items, 0 wire mismatches), feature cap did not fire. Accuracy / macro-F1: 0 baseline 0.56/0.413; A 0.48/0.365 (promoted relational_care); F 0.51/0.415; F-rand 0.50/0.397; A+F 0.50/0.406. All differences within dev-100 noise except A accuracy -8 pts. Waiting on owner to look before L2 (rounds 2-3).
